The '''Carpastor system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] that was located in the [[Rolion sector/Legends|Rolion sector]], within the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]<ref name="EAOC" /> and [[Trans-Hydian/Legends|Trans-Hydian]] regions.<ref name="Trans-Hydian" /> The system lay on the [[Salin Corridor/Legends|Salin Corridor]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperspace route]]<ref name="Insider" /> and was the location of the phenomenon known as the [[Carpastor Comet Swarm]].<ref name="Insider" /><ref name="Planetnamia" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Carpastor system was established in the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', which placed the system in grid square Q-7.<ref name="EAOC" />
